aliases: IPTC Social Media Sites Photo Metadata Test Results
Social Media Sites Photo Metadata Test Results

homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. The address's string names the IPTC Photo Metadata Standard, a distinct entity of the same field (the object the tests test), not a sense of the tests' name; the composition at the address substitutes it for the row's entity (CAP-1-02, CAP-1-03). No card is a homonym.
distinct_entities: IPTC Photo Metadata Standard (IPTC Core and IPTC Extension; the carrier the tests test; the address's object)
IPTC Information Interchange Model (the legacy standard; card 6)
IPTC, the International Press Telecommunications Council (the operator)
IPTC Metawatch (census row iptc-metawatch, related has_part; no /non row)
C2PA conformance (census row c2pa-conformance, related neighbour; no /non row)
IPTC Photo Metadata Interoperability Tests (another IPTC test page, saved by the census and not cited by the row)
GetPMD and the IPTC Photo Metadata Inspector (the IPTC's tools; card 10)

T: IPTC Photo Metadata Standard (T composes the standard at the name; CAP-1-02, CAP-1-03)
